result.topic_en: Calculations transforming integrals of a function f (written with F) against x^{n-1} g_n(x/α) into double integrals via a substitution with z^2 - x^2 and z^2 - y^2 factors, evaluating Beta-type integrals in terms of the Gauss Π-function.
result.transcription:
$\int fx\, x^{-n+1}\partial x \frac{x^n}{\alpha} g_n\frac{x}{\alpha} = \Big[p(x)\frac{x^n}{\alpha} g_n\frac{x}{\alpha}\Big]_0^1 + \int_0^1 p(x)\left(\frac{x^n}{\alpha^n} g_n\frac{x}{\alpha}\right)'\frac{\partial x}{x}\alpha^{n}$ [?] $- \frac{x}{\alpha^2}$ [?]
$\int_\alpha^1 F\alpha\,\alpha^{-n}\partial\alpha = \int_0^1 p(x)\frac{x^{n-1}}{\alpha^n} g_n\frac{x}{\alpha}\partial x$ \quad $1>z>x>0$ \quad 38
$=\alpha^{-n}\int_0^1 d(F y\, y^n)\int_0^1 x^{n-1} g_n\left(\frac{x}{\alpha}\right)\partial x\int_x^1 z^{-2n+2}(z^2-x^2)^{-\frac12}(z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z$
$=\alpha^{-n}\int_0^1 dF y\, y^n\int_0^1 z^{-2n+2}(z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z\int_0^z x^{n-1}(z^2-x^2)^{-\frac12} g_n\left(\frac{x}{\alpha}\right)\partial x$
$=\alpha^{-n}\int_0^1 d(F y\, y^n)\int_y^1 z^{-n+1}(z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z\int_0^1 \xi^{n-1}(1-\xi^2)^{-\frac12} g_n\left(\frac{\xi z}{\alpha}\right)\partial\xi$
$=\alpha^{-n}\int_0^1 dF y\, y^n\int_\infty^1 z^{-n+1}(z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z\int_0^1 \xi^{n-1}(1-\xi^2)^{-\frac12} g_n\left(\frac{\xi z}{\alpha}\right)\partial\xi$
$+\alpha^{-n}\int_0^1 dF y\, y^n\cdot y^{-n+1}\int_0^1 t^{n-2}(1-t^2)^{-\frac12}\partial t\int_0^1 \xi^{n-1}(1-\xi^2)^{-\frac12} g_n\left(\frac{\xi y}{t\alpha}\right)\partial\xi$
$\int_0^1 \xi^{n-1}(1-\xi^2)^{-\frac12} g_n\left(\frac{\xi}{r}\right)\partial\xi = r^n\frac12\Pi\left(-\frac12\right)\cdot\Pi\left(n-\frac12\right)(-1)^n\cdot\Pi(n-1)$ \quad $r<1$
$= r^n\frac12\left(\Pi-\frac12\right)^3\cdot\frac{\Pi n-1}{\Pi\left(n-\frac12\right)}$ \quad $r g_n r = g_n\frac1r$
$+[-\alpha^{n}-]\int_\alpha^1 dF y\, y^n\cdot y^{-2n+1}\int_0^1 t^{2n-2}(1-t^2)^{-\frac12}\partial t\;\frac12\left(\Pi-\frac12\right)^3\cdot\frac{\Pi n-1}{\Pi\left(n-\frac12\right)}$
$=\int_0^1 s^{n-\frac32}(1-s)^{-\frac12}\partial s$ \quad $\frac14$
$+\int_\alpha^1 d(F y\, y^n)\cdot y^{-2n+1}\;\frac14\cdot\left(\Pi-\frac12\right)^4\frac{1}{n-\frac12}$
$+\alpha^{-2n+1}\int_0^\alpha dF y\, y^n$ [-$\int_0^1 \xi^{2n-2}(1-\xi^2)^{-\frac12}\partial\xi$-] $\frac14\left(\Pi-\frac12\right)^4\frac{1}{n-\frac12}$
$+[-\alpha-]\int_0^1 dF y\, y^n\int_\infty^1 z^{-2n+1}(z^2-y^2)^{-\frac12}\partial z\;\frac12\left(\Pi-\frac12\right)^3\cdot\frac{\Pi n-1}{\Pi n-\frac12}$
$\alpha^{-2n+1}\cdot F\alpha\cdot\alpha^n + F1 - F\alpha\, a^n\alpha^{-2n+1} + \int_\alpha^1 F y\, y^{-n}\partial y\;\frac12\left(\Pi-\frac12\right)^4$
$\alpha^{-2n+1}(F y\, y^n)_0^\alpha$
